analysis: The changes in this batch are documentation-only. docs/architecture/components/console-ui.md is removed entirely (base lines 1-338). docs/developer/build.md drops the 'Retained Console' section, the `make ui-install ui-build` build step, the `lint-console` CI routing entry, and the console wording in the troubleshooting text. The patch contains no runtime source, workflow YAML, build scripts or provider code. The visible diff changes no provider code, no coordinator-to-provider WebSocket contract, and no provider keys, attestation or App Attest authorization paths. The threat model's in-scope items (TB-002, TB-003, TB-007, TB-009 to TB-012, T-041 and the cache and App Attest threats) do not depend on the removed console documentation. The removed docs described console security behaviours: the CSP, Privy-token handling, sealing, mock-auth warnings and the invariants that the coordinator origin is never client-controlled and that API keys are forwarded only as Bearer tokens. Console and backend are explicitly out of scope for this repo's threat model, so removing the docs does not invalidate any in-scope assumption or mitigation. The T-041 definition stays untouched. Unverified contract: the diff shows docs/developer/build.md no longer mentions `lint-console`, `ui-*` Make targets or console-ui, but the actual deletion of console-ui/, the Makefile targets, ci.yml lanes or the pre-commit hook is outside the supplied evidence. If a console-ui directory remains deployed or built without its documented security invariants, that is a documentation gap, not a demonstrable regression. Other PR files that remove the console source were not supplied. Integration should check whether console-ui/ source, hosting config (vercel.json) and CI are actually removed in the same PR. It should also check that no remaining doc cross-links, such as docs/reference/configuration.md#console-ui or the navigation docs, point to the deleted console-ui.md and break provider-security documentation references. No findings.
